course.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Consider a single crystal of BCC iron oriented such that a tensile stress 65 MPa is applied along [010] direction. The critical resolved shear stress is 40 MPa for (110) [111] slip system. Is there any slip? If no slip occur, what will happen finally to material with increasing load?
